claims.text: In Agents, MCP-backed tools are available in Plan and Execute mode and in auto mode.
MCP tools are not available as individual single-step selections in Agent Builder.
Custom actions fit internal APIs or services Glean does not support out of the box, legacy or in-house systems, and approvals, validation, or custom business logic before writing to a system.
Builders add a custom action as a step in Agent Builder, and its inputs can be fixed values, user inputs, or AI-predicted values.
Custom actions can be combined with By Glean and By datasource actions in the same workflow.
An example custom action is an internal IT onboarding action that creates a request and returns a request ID plus a link.
BLD-103 is a hands-on workshop building actions and MCP-backed flows.

The Glean Actions and Integrations course covers departmental use cases, actions and MCP including building custom actions and connecting a remote MCP server, integrations such as the Client API and ServiceNow ticket resolution, and a hands-on build workshop.
The Glean Actions and Integrations course is advanced level, runs 2 to 4 hours, and expects experience with RESTful APIs.
